intro.text: New machines, pipes and creatures, **step by step**, with pictures from the game.

intro.tip: Click a picture to enlarge it. Lost the book? Type **/aquamarine help**.

content.text: Hover an item and press **R** to see its recipe, or **U** to see what it is used for.
The metal behind almost all of the industry. Combine copper and gold at a crafting table:

content.caption: 3 copper ingots + 1 gold nugget make 3 brass.

content.text: The **core** of the machines: the Pump, Tank, Compressor and Lung each need one. It comes from oysters (chapter 6).

content.step: Click the **end of a pipe** that touches a machine with the Wrench.
Each click switches that side: **out** (amber arrow), **in** (cyan arrow) and **off** (red X).

content.caption: The amber arrow on top of the pipe points at the machine: the pipe delivers (out).

content.text: **Out**: the pipe delivers to the machine. **In**: the pipe pulls from the machine. Machines push on their own, so the default (out) almost always works.
Clicking the **face of a machine** (Tank, Pump, Compressor, Lung) switches that side of the machine itself. The message on screen shows the mode.

content.tip: Click between two pipes to cut or rejoin them. Sneaking, the Wrench rotates the machine.

content.text: **Vent Generator**: 32 E/t with a magma block below and water above (or with Tanks, chapter 4).

content.caption: A Vent underwater, on top of a magma block.

content.text: **Current Turbine**: 4 E/t per side with flowing water. **Wave Buoy**: on the surface, 4 E/t; double in rain.

content.step: Place the generator.
Run **Aquatic Cable** from the generator to the machine. It connects by itself and shows a blue ring on it.
Done: the generator pushes energy through the cable.

content.caption: Vent, Aquatic Cable and Tide Pump.

content.text: **Reinforced Cable**: 2048 E/t (the plain one carries 256). **Switch**: click to cut the energy. **Window**: shows the charge passing.

content.tip: Click a generator with an empty hand to see its charge and what it makes right now.

content.text: Carries **water** or **lava**, one at a time: 1 bucket per second at each output (the Reinforced Pipe carries 4).

content.step: Place the Pump **touching a water source**. In a lake or the sea the source never runs out (2 neighbor sources and ground below).

content.caption: A Pump at the edge of a lake.

content.step: Power it with a **Cable** from a generator. Each bucket costs 160 E.

content.caption: A Vent Generator powering the Pump through a cable.

content.step: Run a **Pipe** from the Pump to a **Water Tank**. The water flows by itself, 1 bucket per second.

content.caption: Water reaches the Tank and the level rises.

content.text: Holds **64 buckets**. Stack them to add up: the top one drains into the one below. Each column holds one liquid (water or lava).

content.caption: A column of three Tanks: 192 buckets.

content.step: A full bucket on the Tank empties it in; an empty bucket fills up.
The Tank **takes from every side and outputs at the bottom**. To output on a side, click it with the Wrench until the message says **out**.

content.tip: **Valve**: click to open or close the pipe. **Window**: shows the liquid passing. A broken pipe with water leaves a source.

content.text: The Vent makes **32 E/t** in two ways.

content.step: Place a **magma block** on the sea floor.
Put the Vent on top of it, with **water above** it.

content.caption: Bubbles from the chimney: the Vent is running.

content.step: Place the Vent anywhere, even on dry land.
Fill one **Tank with water** and another **with lava** (bucket or Pump).
Set each Tank **on top of a Pipe** (it outputs at the bottom) and run the Pipe to a side of the Vent, **except the front** (the one with the dial).

content.caption: Lava on one side, water on the other: the Vent works on land.

content.text: It uses 1 bucket of water every 30 s and 1 of lava every 2.5 min. The Vent sorts water and lava by itself.

content.tip: With a full charge it uses nothing. World mode comes first, since it is free.

content.text: A generator fed **Compressed Air** through an Air Tube makes **25% more** (the Vent goes to 40 E/t).
Uses 8 E/t and makes 1 bucket of air every 10 s. It pushes the air into the Tubes connected to it.
Holds **256 buckets** of air. **Takes from the sides and releases from the back**, 1 bucket per second. When full it only vents: it never explodes.

content.step: Power the Compressor with a **Cable**.
Run an **Air Tube** from the Compressor to one side of the Lung.

content.caption: Compressor, Air Tube and Iron Lung.

content.step: From the **back** of the Lung, run another Tube to the generators.

content.caption: Lung, Air Tube and a regulated Vent.

content.step: Each generator with air uses 1 bucket every 30 s. Without air it goes back to normal.

content.tip: The Air Tube does not connect to Pipes or liquid machines. On the Vent it connects on any side except the front.

content.text: Lives on the floor of **warm oceans**. Closes its shell when someone gets close. **15%** carry a Pearl, dropped when the oyster dies.

content.caption: Oysters on a warm ocean floor.

content.step: Underwater, place a **Cultivation Jar**.
Next to it, a **Cultivation Rope**; keep alternating Jar and Rope in a **straight line**.
End the line with a **Cultivation Buoy**. All facing the same way.

content.caption: Jar, Rope, Jar, Rope and Buoy.

content.step: Wait: each Jar makes **1 pearl every 8 min** (+10% per neighbor Jar, up to +50%).
Click the **Buoy** to see the production and collect the pearls.

content.tip: The water must be clean: no magma block near the Jars.

content.text: In the **Abyssal Forge**, Raw Aurium + Pearl make 2 Aurium ingots.
Rare, on **beaches**. Walks sideways, burrows into the sand when scared and comes back later. Cornered, it pinches. More active at night.

content.step: Give it **raw fish** (cod, salmon or tropical): it waves, gains hearts, stays tame for a minute and no longer despawns.
When it dies it drops the **Crab Shell**.

content.text: A stronger shield: **672 durability** (double), recovers faster when an axe disables it and whales push you less.

content.tip: Use it like any shield: hold right-click to block.
